premise: A municipal hub where gravity is a licensed commodity, managed through tradeable vectors and ballast mortgages.
simulation_objective: Simulate a social economy where movement and access are dictated by the ownership and exchange of physical gravity rights.
economy_focus: Gravity-rights licensing, ballast mortgaging, and vector arbitration.
exploration_focus: Navigating six functionally distinct rooms with varying physical constraints based on held licenses.
conflict_tone: Bureaucratic disputes over counterfeit vectors and accidental spatial collisions.
visual_style: Cobalt glass and bone-white ceramic surfaces with vermilion plumb lines and brass measurement hardware.

agent_visual_policy.world_wardrobe_brief: A clinical, bureaucratic aesthetic where attire is defined by gravity-management utility. Clothing features rigid ceramic plates, cobalt glass visors, and brass calibration hardware to signify rank and spatial stability.

role_style_rules.palette_notes: Dark graphite with high-visibility vermilion lines.
High contrast cobalt and brass highlights.
Heavy use of shadow and dark cobalt.

visual_consistency_rules: Use 1px graphite outlines for all clothing edges.
Represent brass hardware as single-pixel gold highlights.
Ensure vermilion accents are strictly horizontal or vertical lines.

visual_canon.lighting: Clinical overhead fluorescent, sharp graphite shadows, no ambient occlusion

terrain.ground: bone-white ceramic tiles with 1px graphite grout
terrain.path: cobalt glass floor strips with brass trim
terrain.edge: vermilion boundary lines and raised brass curbs
